review.name: Skyglass Kirin
findings: Original twelve source head/body slices, original four-view hoof overlay and all 216 actual technique frames inspected. Front-leg joints sit behind the visible legs; standing attack folds the torso below the platform and slides front soles up to 1.347. Candidate fits four limb chains and coordinates attack/cast/recoil, with three support feet and one intentionally lifted front hoof for attack. All twelve candidate raw slices and all 216 candidate technique frames inspected and pass. Sculpt, original 21 frames/inverses, textures and 172 unaffected authored curves conserved. Six frozen face patches pass 818 clip poses plus 468 blends; full geometry 485 poses zero warnings. Repeat generated battle and runtime review pending.

Final separate second pass actually inspected all 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Frozen face 818 clip poses plus 468 blends and full-geometry 485 poses per asset pass. Eleven anatomical regression tests plus three animation-bank tests and production build pass. Original and final hoof surfaces are tested at 481 times per action, including between keys. Whole-roster and live release pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-012-anatomical-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual techniques inspected front and side at twelve times on rebuilt battle asset. Complete jaw and mane hold shape, four legs remain connected to the torso, and no strike sinks below the platform. Attack intentionally lifts the left front hoof with three supporting feet; cast and recoil keep four supporting feet.

review.faceCameraCoverage: One kirin head above a long neck. Brow, snout, chin, true side lower jaw, top head curl and cheek mane sampled independently. Side chin was selected on actual visible mesh after two attempted points hit empty space. Four hooves, long neck, mane and tail require full motion review.
